item.title: Cisco engineers scale generative and agentic AI with AWS AI League
item.description:
Cisco engineers scale generative and agentic AI with AWS AI League

Cisco engineers are scaling their use of generative and agentic AI through the AWS AI League competition.

🔍 Overview

  • Cisco is adopting generative and agentic AI to change how its engineers build software.
  • The hard part is no longer access to the technology.
  • Recorded sessions and slide decks rarely close that gap.
  • Engineers learn fastest when they build something real, see it fail, fix it, and try again.

🛠️ How it works

  • Learn – A hands‑on, 2‑hour workshop led by AWS experts introduces the tools and the challenge.
  • Build – Participants experiment at their own pace, submit to a live leaderboard, and receive real‑time feedback from an automated evaluator.
  • Compete – Top finalists take the stage in a live, game‑show‑style grand finale.

🎮 Competition Highlights

  • 2025: Hemanth V, a Cisco software engineer, went from an internal Cisco event to being crowned the first AWS AI League Champion at AWS re:Invent 2025.
  • 2026: 1,200 Cisco engineers competed in an AWS AI League tournament at Cisco Transformation Fest 4.0.
  • Winner Nishanth Aluhonnu earned a full event pass to AWS re:Invent 2026 in Las Vegas.

🤖 Challenges

  • Agentic AI challenge – Participants build agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. The agents move through a maze‑like grid toward a treasure chest.
  • Model customization challenge – Participants fine‑tune models in Amazon SageMaker Studio using the latest training recipes.

Challenge tasks

Challenge Real‑world task
Handling inappropriate content Handling inappropriate content
Running code Running code
Retrieving information from the web Retrieving information from the web
Extracting structured data Extracting structured data

📦 Cisco Use Cases

  • Cisco SD‑WAN – Controller architecture runs on AWS and serves customers globally as a SaaS application.
  • Cisco Cloud Control – Cloud‑native, AI‑powered application integrated with AWS services for security, networking, observability, and collaboration.
  • Cisco AI Defense – Uses Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker AI to embed AI governance and guardrails across the Cisco portfolio.
  • Recent co‑innovation: SD‑WAN fabric on demand across the AWS backbone.

💡 Why it matters

  • AWS AI League helps organizations build advanced AI skills through competition.
  • The program moves engineers from watching demos to confidently building with generative and agentic AI.
  • The partnership is described as “a true engineering partnership” rather than a vendor relationship.

#Cisco #AWS #AILeague #GenerativeAI

Source: From learning to leaderboard: How Cisco upskilled 1,200 engineers in agentic AI with AWS AI League | Amazon Web Services

item.title: Atos and AWS partner to upskill 400 engineers in agentic AI development
item.description:
Atos and AWS partner to upskill 400 engineers in agentic AI development

Atos recently completed an intensive upskilling initiative for 400 engineers focused on practical agentic AI development through a partnership with AWS.

🔍 Overview

Atos addressed the challenge of building real-world agentic AI capability beyond theoretical knowledge by partnering with AWS in 2026. They ran a three-day competitive event using AWS AI League and Workshop Studio, enabling engineers to progress from foundational skills to deploying multi-agent systems with pathfinding, guardrails, memory, and fine-tuned models.

🧩 How it worked

Engineers participated in a gamified challenge where they built autonomous AI agents to navigate a dungeon maze. Agents had to:

  • Find paths through maps
  • Solve tile challenges
  • Avoid traps
  • Reach treasure within time/life limits

Scoring combined performance (correct answers, coin collection, map completion) and efficiency (concise responses, life retention). Teams competed on a live leaderboard.

⚙️ Key details

  • Participant experience levels: 5% no prior knowledge, 25% basic awareness, 50% theoretical understanding (no hands-on), 20% practical experience.
  • Event structure:
    • 2-hour kick-off workshop
    • Daily 1-hour office hours
    • 1-hour finale for top 3 teams
  • AWS services used: Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, AWS Lambda, Kiro, SageMaker.

🧱 Core components

Engineers utilized specialized agent modules with distinct capabilities:

Component Function AWS Services Used
Violent Violet AI safety/content filtering Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
Blue Brain Code generation/execution AWS Lambda, AgentCore Code Interpreter
Memento Context retention AgentCore Memory
Dark Prophet Web information retrieval AWS Lambda, AgentCore Code Interpreter
Bonehead Token-efficient general knowledge Amazon Bedrock (prompt engineering)
Healthcare API Structured data extraction Amazon Bedrock (prompt engineering)
Keys & Doors Context retention AgentCore Memory
Spikes & Coins Pathfinding/risk assessment AWS Lambda

💡 Why it matters

This initiative demonstrates large-scale practical upskilling in agentic AI using cloud-native tools. Engineers gained immediately applicable skills through competitive hands-on development, with all solutions built on production-ready AWS services. The event format required minimal setup while delivering measurable capability advancement aligned with Atos’s strategic commitment to Sovereign Agentic AI Studios.

#AIagents #AWS #Atos #AgenticAI #Upskilling #AILeague

Source: From theory to delivery: How Atos upskilled 400 engineers in agentic AI | Amazon Web Services
